info.title: PIM_Mroute
info.description: RESTful interface for AOS-CX switch software

address_family.description: The IP version of this multicast route entry.

connected_source.description: Indicates if the source for the mroute is directly connected.

creation_time.description: Time in seconds since epoch when this multicast route entry was instantiated in the system.

creation_time_micro_seconds.description: Time in Micro seconds since epoch when this multicast route entry was instantiated in the system.

group_address.description:
Reference Resource: [PIM_Mroute](#/PIM_Mroute)
The Group Address of the stream.

l3_vni.description:
Reference Resource: [Virtual_Network_ID](#/Virtual_Network_ID)
Upstream L3 Virtual Network Identifier on which the source stream is received.

metric.description: Unicast routing table metric associated with this route to reach the multicast source.

metric_pref.description: Preference value assigned to the unicast routing protocol that provided the route to the multicast source.

pim_nexthops.description:
Reference Resource: [PIM_Nexthop](#/PIM_Nexthop)
The outgoing list of [PIM_Nexthop](#/PIM_Nexthop)s associated with this route entry. A route is a bridge entry if nexthops are empty or if it points to nexthops that are all in pruned state.

pim_ssm_route.description: Indicates if this is an SSM mroute.

port.description:
Reference Resource: [PIM_Mroute](#/PIM_Mroute)
The upstream [Port](#/Port) on which the source stream is received.

source_address.description:
Reference Resource: [PIM_Mroute](#/PIM_Mroute)
The Source Address of the stream.

sw_only_flow.description: Indicates if this is a software only flow and no hardware programming is required.

underlay_replication_mroute.description: Indicates if this is a underlay replication mroute.

unicast_routing_protocol.description: Unicast routing protocol through which the router learned the upstream port for this route entry.

upstream_neighbor.description: Upstream neighbor address corresponding to this multicast stream.

parameters.name: Interface.name
parameters.description:
Reference Resource: [Port](#/Port)
The port name. For non-bonded ports, the port name is the same as the associated interface name. The name must otherwise be unique across all ports and interfaces of the system.

parameters.name: selector
parameters.description: Select configuration, status and/or statistics. Default is all categories.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Filter rows by attribute values.  Format: attribute:value

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Count the number of rows found.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: Entity-tag value for representation comparison (see RFC 7232 - Conditional Requests - section 3.2)
